title: Monochromatic Union-Closed Families in the Boolean Lattice (Erdős Problem 1183), with a Lean 4 formalization
description: Paper, code and Lean 4 formalization for Erdős Problem 1183 (Erdős–Ulam). Let F(n) be the largest m such that every 2-colouring of the subsets of {1,…,n} contains a monochromatic union-closed family of m sets. Via a first-moment argument and the Sauer–Shelah lemma, F(n) ≤ Σ_{j<d} C(n,j) whenever 2^d > nd + 2, so F(n) ≤ n^{(1+o(1)) log₂ n} and F(n) < (1+ε)^n for every ε > 0 and all large n. This settles Erdős's second conjecture for the problem. The bound, the asymptotic statement, and the trivial lower bound ⌈(n+1)/2⌉ ≤ f(n) ≤ F(n) are machine-checked in Lean 4 with Mathlib, with no sorry and no axioms beyond Lean's standard ones. Erdős's first conjecture (F(n) > n^c for every fixed c) remains open and is not claimed. The deposit also contains the SAT-based code computing f(n) for n ≤ 10 and F(n) for n ≤ 7.
